newsitem.title: USA: Belco Systems, Iron Holdings, cancel deal.
newsitem.headline: Belco Systems, Iron Holdings, cancel deal.

text.p: Belco Systems Technologies Inc and Iron Holdings Corp said Monday they decided not to enter into a previously announced exclusive license agreement.
"Belco is currently exploring many other opportunities to market its personal reader capture technology (PRCTT)," said Lionel Beloyan, Chairman of the Board of Belco Systems.

Belco Systems owns patent pending technology which permits secure credit card transactions from any remote location. Belco's (PRCTT) has been designed to permit direct communication between a customer and merchant via a telephone line while it electronically sends credit card information to the merchant.
